name: frost
dataset_ref: IMD Pune 1.0 deg gridded daily Tmin 1951-2025 (https://www.imdpune.gov.in/cmpg/Griddata/Min_1_Bin.html, POST https://www.imdpune.gov.in/cmpg/Griddata/mintemp.php) and Tmax 1951-2025 (https://www.imdpune.gov.in/cmpg/Griddata/Max_1_Bin.html, POST https://www.imdpune.gov.in/cmpg/Griddata/maxtemp.php); IMD 0.25 deg gridded daily rainfall 2015-2025 (https://www.imdpune.gov.in/cmpg/Griddata/Rainfall_25_Bin.html) averaged to 1 deg; Open-Meteo Previous Runs API (https://previous-runs-api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast) model jma_seamless, hourly temperature_2m and precipitation previous_day1..3, 2016-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (windows 1 Jan-15 Jun and 15 Nov-31 Dec), at 33 Maharashtra 1 deg IMD cell centres; evaluation only: the same API with model best_match, Dec 2021 to Dec 2025 scoring months; Open-Meteo elevation API (https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/elevation). IMD file fingerprint sha256 7e395310b7ec8680, Open-Meteo fingerprint 6e6774346f7d375f.

frost.selection: lower pooled Brier over scoring thresholds and leads, out of fold

transfer_to_serving_model.note: same out-of-fold models; matched rows only

long_record_imd.note: IMD 1 degree, all 33 cells, scoring months only

heat.selection: lower pooled Brier over scoring thresholds and leads, out of fold

transfer_to_serving_model.note: same out-of-fold models; matched rows only

long_record_imd.note: IMD 1 degree, all 33 cells, scoring months only

validation.scheme: leave-one-season-out (year-blocked); every season held out whole, so no event (consecutive-day run at a cell) straddles train and test
validation.event_definition: a run of consecutive days at one 1 deg cell with the event true
validation.preliminary_rule: fewer than 30 events at 48 h: preliminary, recall n/a
validation.climatology_reference: IMD seasons 1996-2025 excluding the test season, same cell, +-15 days
validation.class_weighting: balanced class weights, then Platt (sigmoid) recalibration on held-out seasons (inner 3-fold GroupKFold by season)
validation.lead_mapping: 24/48/72 h = Open-Meteo previous_day1/2/3 (about N*24 to N*24+6 h)

notes: Forecast-error model (stage 1: bias and heteroscedastic spread of IMD minus JMA GSM, with an empirical residual distribution that gives the 80% band) plus calibrated classifiers with the threshold as an input (stage 2: logistic regression on the stage 1 margin and a climatological margin; LightGBM challenger with monotone constraints). Both class weighted and Platt-recalibrated on held-out seasons. Trained on archived JMA GSM forecasts, the only free archive with 10 years at 48 h. Live serving (foundry/openmeteo.py) passes Open-Meteo best_match; that transfer is scored separately below. 1 degree IMD cell skill only: it cannot resolve a frost pocket, valley or slope inside a cell. Ensemble spread, station distance and observed lags are not model inputs (no training data or not available in real time); see the model card. frost transfer test (same held-out rows, Dec 2021 to Dec 2025), 48 h BSS with JMA input -> best_match input: 8C 0.2572 -> 0.1936; 10C 0.2682 -> 0.1695. Skill drops; feed the classifier JMA forecasts. heat transfer test (same held-out rows, Dec 2021 to Dec 2025), 48 h BSS with JMA input -> best_match input: 38C 0.3876 -> 0.3356; 40C 0.3816 -> 0.3264; 42C 0.2083 -> 0.0332; 43C -0.0132 -> -0.347. Skill drops; feed the classifier JMA forecasts. frost: preliminary (fewer than 30 events at 48 h) at 4C, 4.4C, 6C. frost: Brier skill score vs climatology not positive at 48 h for 4C, 4.4C, 6C. heat: preliminary (fewer than 30 events at 48 h) at 45C.
